context.transcript:
Welcome to this instructional video.
Many subscribers to my channel have asked about installing ceiling fans, so I thought I'd help.
Your first steps are to shut off the electricity in the room, put on protective eye covering, and make sure you have a sturdy ladder.
These are essential for your safety.
Once the electricity is off, hold the base of the fan to the ceiling and draw a circle around it with a pencil.
Then, cut along the circle with a drywall saw.
The saw will shake quite strongly, so I suggest asking a friend to hold the ladder while you do it.
context.transcript_translation:
欢迎观看本教学视频。
我的频道有很多订阅者询问关于安装吊扇的问题，所以我决定来帮助大家。
第一步是关闭房间的电源，戴上防护眼罩，并确保您有一把结实的梯子。
这些对您的安全至关重要。
一旦电源关闭，将风扇底座固定在天花板上，然后用铅笔画一个圆圈。
接着，沿着这个圆圈用石膏板锯切割。
这台锯会震动得相当厉害，所以我建议让朋友帮忙扶着梯子您进行操作。
